environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate tasks in a private subnet (subnet-0xf7a2e) within VPC vpc-0d9c8b7a. The subnet route table (rtb-04e3f1a) has NO route to a NAT gateway or Internet Gateway — only local VPC CIDR routes (10.0.0.0/16) and a VPC endpoint route for ECR (vpce-0abc123). The ALB is internal-only (scheme: internal) accessible only from the corporate VPN CIDR 172.16.0.0/12. Security group sg-0fe2d1c on the tasks allows inbound only from sg-0ab3c4d (ALB SG) on port 8080, and egress is restricted to 10.0.0.0/16 on port 5432 (PostgreSQL) only. No S3 gateway endpoint, no SQS endpoint, no other VPC endpoints exist. DNS resolution is via Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint for internal zones only.

config.route_table: rtb-04e3f1a: local 10.0.0.0/16 only, vpce-0abc123 for com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ecr.dkr
config.task_security_group: sg-0fe2d1c: ingress tcp/8080 from sg-0ab3c4d only, egress tcp/5432 to 10.0.0.0/16 only
config.dns: Route53 Resolver for internal zones, no public DNS resolution
